windows.acceptance_scope: Exact reviewed builds. Windows 11.4.7 additionally covers local single-timeline multitrack video, programmatic keyframes and easing, speed, basic text, static local TTF/OTF fonts, native audio fades (type 4), audited typed edits and native-frame preview. Byte-specific VFX includes four filters (including retro LOMO and silent film), default glow/mild-shake/blur, white-flash 400/600 ms, local original-shader dissolve/fog/slide-left/slide-right compatibility scenes at 400/600/800/1200 ms, circle geometry and five per-mask linear channels using the unchanged modern official circle package for true feather. Mask geometry uses width/height .05..1 and half-canvas centers -1..1; modern feather 0..1. Mask animation requires forward 1x, source start 0 and linear points. Audited EncryptUtils repairs bind the modern package and native protocol; rendering verifies the 48-file builtin runtime. Original GeneralEffect routing is not repaired. GUI save/cold reopen, unknown resources and legacy native_edit remain unverified. Inputs are saved disk state; edits may use official resource resolution. Preview/export use local snapshots without an extra Windows network sandbox. No mouse, keyboard or desktop screenshot automation. Fog v3 repairs paused-player capture by reusing restored scene cameras and serialized RTs, with original shaders/AE/masks preserved. Preview always captures VEF1 directly, without export/frame decoding. Exact legacy v2 packages upgrade only inside the isolated preview snapshot with an audit; source drafts remain unchanged.
